Armory of the Empire

Gunpowder and engineering attachments, munitions, and modifications used across the Empire (Nations of Mankind PDF, pages 78–80). Pair these with Core blackpowder rules and the NoM weapon lists.

Bandolier

A bandolier is a shoulder-belt with loops or pockets for storing ammo. Bandoliers are more often used by gunners as their convenience allows them to more quickly and easily reload readily prepared ammo.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons and Crossbows

Availability: Common

Cost: 9 Silver Shillings

Effect: Adds 3 Encumbrance for storing ammunition and gives +1 SL to any Extended Test to reload a ranged weapon.

Breech-Loader

Thanks to recent advances in firearms within the Human Engineering Guilds and less conservative Dwarf Engineers, breech-loading for firearms has entered into the market as a new and expensive way of combating reload times.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 10 GC

Effect: A ranged weapon with a breech-loader may perform an Extended Test to reload as a Free Action. However, if you do this, you may not attempt another reload this Turn.

Bayonet

A bayonet is a knife, sword, or spike-shaped weapon designed to fit on the end of the muzzle of a rifle, musket or similar firearm, allowing it to be used as a spear.

Applies to: Pistols and 2-Handed Crossbows and Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Common

Cost: Varies

Effect: A bayonet removes the Undamaging Flaw for any ranged weapon that is being used as an Improvised Weapon during melee combat with the weapon’s Damage equal to SB + Damage depending on the weapon selected. Its Reach varies depending on the length of the weapon equipped. If the GM wishes, the Melee (Polearm) or Melee (Two-handed) Skill may be required to effectively use a 2-Handed ranged weapon with a bayonet.

Dragon’s Breathe Shot

Experimentation between the Engineering Guilds and the Alchemists of the Gold Order have created a devastating concoction for firearms.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 1 GC per small shot and powder

Effect: Adds the Incendiary effect to the standard Small Shot and Powder (WFRP Core Rulebook).

Dwarfen Gunpowder

Dwarfen gunpowder is the best quality one can find within the Empire and is said to be the key secret behind the Dwarf’s higher reliability with Blackpowder weaponry.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Rare

Cost: 1 GC and 10 Silver Shillings for 12 Shots Worth or 6 GC for one Bomb

Effect: Weapons using Dwarfen gunpowder ignore the Dangerous Flaw, if they have it, and increase their Damage by +1.

Extended Barrel

Longer and larger gun barrels further extend the range of firearms across the Empire, at the cost of material and weight.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Rare

Cost: 8 GC

Effect: Increases Range by 50% and Encumbrance by 1.

Grenade Launcher Modification

A permanent modification for the common blunderbuss allowing it to fire explosives from a safe but effective distance.

Applies to: Blunderbusses

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 20 GC

Effect: May shoot Bombs as ammunition instead of listed blackpowder/engineering ammunition. Damage and Weapon Qualities are replaced with the Bomb’s; Encumbrance increased by 2.

Gromril Coated Bullets

Coating common bullets with carefully applied liquid Gromril creates exceptionally deadly munitions.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 2 GC per bullet

Effect: Adds the Impact Weapon Quality and +3 Damage to the standard Bullet and Powder. Gromril bullets may be recollected for future use.

Laurelorn Maple Wood Frame

Higher quality materials for lighter and more durable ranged weaponry, hard to obtain under Wood Elf logging regulations.

Applies to: Ranged Weapons

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 10 GC

Effect: Gains the Durable and Lightweight Qualities.

Musket Rest

Portable forked poles that support the barrel of a blackpowder longarm.

Applies to: 2-Handed Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Scarce

Cost: 1 GC

Effect: Makes the weapon easier to aim (+10 to hit) but requires an Action to place the weapon in the rest after reloading. Weighs 1 Encumbrance if carried.

Octagon Multi-Barrel

A cumbersome but effective overhaul for Repeater Rifle and Pistol that doubles maximum firepower and adds a volley mode.

Applies to: Repeater Rifle and Pistol

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 10 GC

Effect: Gains Repeater 8 and Reload 10 Flaw; Encumbrance +1. As an Action, fire all available shots at once on a single target, adding Blast equal to every 2 bullets shot (max Blast 4). Each such shot requires an Average (+20) Endurance Test (1 Wound per Failure level; Astounding Failure = Critical Hit to the shoulder).

Powder Horn

A long curved container that keeps black powder dry; common among hunters and soldiers.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Common

Cost: 4 Silver Shillings and 6 Brass Pennies

Effect: +1 SL to any Extended Test to reload a blackpowder ranged weapon. Also protects gunpowder from rain or snow.

Pistol Grip

Repurposed grips attached underbarrel to increase stability and aiming speed.

Applies to: 2-Handed Crossbows and Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Rare

Cost: 4 GC

Effect: Does not inflict the penalty for shooting after moving. You can take the Aim Action as a Free Action, but must still wait until next round before applying the +20 Difficulty Modifier.

Pistol Sword

A sword with a pistol or repeater attached alongside the blade; both functions usable without switching hands.

Applies to: Swords and rapiers

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 20 GC

Effect: Functions as both a melee weapon and a ranged weapon (pistol or repeater pistol sidearm). Either function may be used as if in the same hand; no Free Action required to switch.

Rifling

Helical grooving machined into a barrel’s bore to spin the projectile and improve accuracy.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Rare

Cost: 4 GC per barrel

Effect: Gains the Precise Quality and increases the weapon’s Range by 20%.

Reinforced Rifle Frame

Heavier metallic components crafted by master gunsmiths for tougher frames.

Applies to: Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Rare

Cost: 4 GC

Effect: Gains the Durable Quality, and has the Undamaging Flaw removed if used as an improvised weapon. If the weapon has a Bayonet, Damage +1.

Rune Tipped Bolts

Dwarfen crossbow bolts forged under a Runesmith’s hand, etched with powerful runes along their tips.

Applies to: Crossbows

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 1 GC per bolt

Effect: Adds Accurate and Penetrating Qualities, +50 Range and +2 Damage to the standard Crossbow Bolt. Attacks count as Magical.

Short-Barrel

A shortened barrel trade-off used for close-range skirmishing.

Applies to: 2-Handed Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Common

Cost: 2 GC

Effect: Decreases Range by 50% and Encumbrance by 1, but you can use this weapon to attack in Close Combat similar to the Pistol Quality.

Silvered Weapons & Ammo

Silvered arms prized by Witch Hunters and Vampire Hunters since the Vampire Wars.

Applies to: Melee Weapons and Ranged Weapon Ammo

Availability: Rare

Cost: 3× the value of the weapon or ammo in silver, plus labour as determined by the GM

Effect: Allows attacks to strike targets with the Ethereal Trait and deals an additional +1 Damage to targets with the Undead Trait.

Steam-Powered Gun Crank

A crank attachment that rapidly increases the fire rate of repeater weapons.

Applies to: Repeater Rifle and Pistol

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 20 GC

Effect: May shoot twice on a single Action once activated. Every round as a Free Action, you must rotate the crank to activate the effect.

Telescopic Sight

Repurposed telescopes adapted for firearms and crossbows, adding increased accuracy to every shot.

Applies to: 2-Handed Crossbows and Blackpowder Weapons

Availability: Rare

Cost: 5 GC

Effect: Gains the Accurate Weapon Quality.

Volley Shot Modification

A Dwarf-engineered crossbow attachment capable of firing multiple bolts in quick succession or in a single volley.

Applies to: 2-Handed Crossbows

Availability: Exotic

Cost: 4 GC

Effect: Gains Repeater 3 and Reload 4 Flaw; Encumbrance +1. As an Action, fire all available bolts at once on a single target: on Success, each bolt is a separate hit (TB and armour apply per bolt); roll hit location per bolt.

New Qualities

Weapon and armour Qualities introduced in Nations of Mankind (PDF pages 82–83).

Concealed

Concealed weapons are designed not to be seen, often strapped around various areas of the wielder’s body under their clothing to avoid detection. If you are wielding such a weapon, no one can easily detect it on your person with their passive perception and would have to conduct a thorough investigation in order to discover it. If used on a surprised target, the weapon temporarily gains the Damaging and Impact Qualities.

Crushing

Crushing weapons are designed with spikes or patterns to smash up, crush and tear into the armour of the wielder’s enemies. If you successfully attack and deal a Critical Hit on an opponent, you Damage a struck piece of armour or shield by 2 points as well as wounding the target. Furthermore, you ignore the Impenetrable Armour Quality for all Critical Hits.

Hooked

Hooked weapons are strategically designed with small hooks on their ends to pull down infantry or rip cavalry off their mounts. After a successful Melee Attack, instead of dealing Damage, you may attempt to pull down your enemy with an Opposed Strength Test. If you succeed, you force the opponent to go prone. If the opponent is mounted, they are forced off their mount and take falling damage.

Multi-shot

This weapon is designed to fire multiple missiles at once in a single action, assuming the weapon is fully loaded and capable of holding more than one missile at a time based on the Repeater Quality’s value. On a Success, the Damage is counted as a separate hit by each missile, with Toughness Bonus and armour deducting the Damage of each shot as normal. Roll a d100 for each separate hit location. If you Fumble, you must roll for two results on the Fumble Table and pick the higher result.

Ninjutsu

This bomb is a product created from years of martial arts mastery and experimentation. A bomb with this Quality may have one of the effects selected below. Whichever effect is selected replaces the Ninjutsu Quality for the number of bombs crafted or purchased and cannot be replaced:

  • Distraction: Any targets within 50 yards of this bomb are immediately alerted to its presence.

  • Smoke: Anyone caught in the radius is Surprised and gains 1+SL Blinded Conditions.

  • Stun: Anyone caught in the radius must pass a Hard (−20) Endurance Test or gain 1+SL Stunned Conditions.

  • Poison: Anyone caught in the radius must pass a Hard (−20) Endurance Test or gain 1+SL Poisoned Conditions.

Suppressed

This weapon is designed to drastically reduce the noise made from firing it. This weapon can be fired without immediately alerting enemies; however, it loses the Blackpowder and Damaging Qualities.

Missile Resistant

This armour is designed to protect the wearer from ranged attacks. While wearing a piece of armour with this quality, missile attacks have their Damage reduced by 2. Furthermore, the Damaging Quality of all ranged weapons is ignored when striking this armour with missile attacks, with the exception of ranged weapons with the Blackpowder Quality.
